articles.abstract_en: Within the framework of the dual self-perception that characterises conspiracy thinking (privileged minority; heroes), this study proposes that conspiracy theorists tend to adopt the role of social vigilantes, seeking to correct the supposed ignorance of others based on what they consider to be superior and inaccessible knowledge. As a result, these individuals end up acting as self-appointed online norm enforcers, often adopting confrontational and punitive behaviours. In light of this, three well-powered studies in Greece and the U.S. (NTotal = 443) investigated the relationships between conspiracy thinking, conspiracy beliefs, social vigilantism (the psychological tendency of individuals to impose their superior beliefs on others to correct what they see as ignorance), and online behaviours. The results indicated a moderate positive association between conspiracy variables and social vigilantism. Furthermore, conspiracy variables indirectly predicted online argumentation, online shaming, and social media conflict through the motivational mechanism of social vigilantism. These effects remained significant after controlling for several variables, but were attenuated when narcissistic admiration was included, suggesting that self-enhancement motives may contribute to the adoption of a social vigilante role. The findings are interpreted considering the extant literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在阴谋思维特有的双重自我认知（特权少数派；英雄）框架内，本研究提出阴谋理论家倾向于扮演社会义警的角色，试图基于他们认为优越且不可获取的知识来纠正他人的所谓无知。因此，这些人最终成为自我任命的网络规范执行者，常常采取对抗性和惩罚性行为。鉴于此，在希腊和美国进行的三项有力研究（总样本量 = 443）调查了阴谋思维、阴谋信念、社会义警主义（个体将其优越信念强加于他人以纠正其所认为的无知的心理倾向）与网络行为之间的关系。结果表明，阴谋变量与社会义警主义之间存在中等程度的正相关。此外，阴谋变量通过社会义警主义的动机机制间接预测了网络争论、网络羞辱和社交媒体冲突。这些效应在控制多个变量后仍然显著，但在纳入自恋式钦佩后有所减弱，表明自我增强动机可能有助于采纳社会义警角色。研究结果结合现有文献进行了解释。

articles.title_en: Internal and external shame and rejection sensitivity as correlates of vulnerable narcissism and social anxiety
articles.title_cn: 内部与外部羞耻感及拒绝敏感性与脆弱自恋和社交焦虑的相关性
articles.abstract_en: Interpersonal rejection sensitivity and shame-related processes have been linked to both social anxiety and vulnerable narcissistic traits. Less is known about whether internal and external shame show differential associations with these outcomes alongside rejection sensitivity and sociodemographic variables.This study examined these associations in a general population sample (N = 400) using self-report measures of rejection sensitivity, internal and external shame, social anxiety symptoms, and vulnerable narcissistic traits. Bivariate correlations and two direct-entry multiple regression models were conducted, with age and sex/gender as predictors.Rejection sensitivity, internal and external shame were positively correlated with both social anxiety symptoms and vulnerable narcissistic traits. In the regression model predicting social anxiety symptoms, internal shame emerged as the only significant predictor. In the model predicting vulnerable narcissistic traits, younger age, higher rejection sensitivity, and higher levels of both types of shame were significant predictors. Sex/gender was not significant in either model.These findings suggest that social anxiety symptoms and vulnerable narcissistic traits present partially distinct correlational profiles despite shared associations with shame and rejection sensitivity. Internal shame appears especially central to social anxiety, whereas vulnerable narcissistic traits are associated with a broader pattern involving rejection sensitivity and both internal and external shame.
articles.abstract_cn: 人际拒绝敏感性和与羞耻相关的过程已被认为与社交焦虑和脆弱自恋特质有关。关于内部和外部羞耻感是否与这些结果以及拒绝敏感性和社会人口学变量存在不同关联，目前知之甚少。本研究在一个普通人群样本（N = 400）中，使用自我报告测量工具评估了拒绝敏感性、内部和外部羞耻感、社交焦虑症状和脆弱自恋特质。进行了双变量相关分析和两个直接进入多元回归模型，其中年龄和性别/生理性别作为预测变量。拒绝敏感性、内部和外部羞耻感与社交焦虑症状和脆弱自恋特质均呈正相关。在预测社交焦虑症状的回归模型中，内部羞耻感成为唯一显著的预测因子。在预测脆弱自恋特质的模型中，年龄较小、拒绝敏感性较高以及两种类型的羞耻感水平较高均为显著预测因子。性别/生理性别在两个模型中均不显著。这些发现表明，尽管社交焦虑症状和脆弱自恋特质与羞耻感和拒绝敏感性存在共同关联，但它们呈现出部分不同的相关模式。内部羞耻感似乎对社交焦虑尤为关键，而脆弱自恋特质则与涉及拒绝敏感性以及内部和外部羞耻感的更广泛模式相关。

articles.title_en: Influence of self-talk valence and self-control on dart-throwing performance: An exploration based on the theory of challenge and threat states in athletes
articles.title_cn: 自我谈话效价与自我控制对飞镖投掷表现的影响：基于运动员挑战与威胁状态理论的探索
articles.abstract_en: Self-talk is a key cognitive intervention strategy, yet little research has examined how individual resources and psychological states moderate the effects of self-talk valence on fine motor performance. Guided by the Theory of Challenge and Threat States in Athletes, this research conducted two experiments to investigate the interactive effects of trait self-control, ego depletion, and self-talk valence on dart-throwing performance. In Study 1, 128 university students completed a baseline dart task, were classified by trait self-control, and after 48 h received either positive or negative self-talk training before a post-test. Study 2 followed the same procedure with 130 students, who were assigned to ego depletion or control conditions. Across both studies, positive self-talk consistently led to superior performance compared with negative self-talk. Participants with high trait self-control outperformed those with low self-control and maintained relatively stable performance even under negative self-talk. Ego depletion impaired performance, particularly when combined with negative self-talk. Overall, positive self-talk enhances fine motor performance, while the harmful effects of negative self-talk are moderated by individuals' available self-control resources. When resources are sufficient, individuals are more likely to enter a challenge state, which strengthens the benefits of positive self-talk and buffers the detrimental impact of negative self-talk.
articles.abstract_cn: 自我谈话是一种关键的认知干预策略，但很少有研究探讨个体资源和心理状态如何调节自我谈话效价对精细运动表现的影响。以运动员挑战与威胁状态理论为指导，本研究进行了两项实验，以考察特质自我控制、自我耗竭和自我谈话效价对飞镖投掷表现的交互作用。在研究1中，128名大学生完成了基线飞镖任务，根据特质自我控制进行分类，并在48小时后接受积极或消极自我谈话训练，然后进行后测。研究二采用相同程序，涉及130名学生，他们被分配到自我耗竭或控制条件。在两项研究中，积极自我谈话始终比消极自我谈话带来更优异的表现。高特质自我控制的参与者表现优于低自我控制者，即使在消极自我谈话下也能保持相对稳定的表现。自我耗竭损害了表现，尤其是在与消极自我谈话结合时。总体而言，积极自我谈话增强精细运动表现，而消极自我谈话的有害影响则受到个体可用自我控制资源的调节。当资源充足时，个体更可能进入挑战状态，这增强了积极自我谈话的益处，并缓冲了消极自我谈话的不利影响。

articles.title_en: Inhibitory control and semantic richness moderate the relationship between autism spectrum characters and creative thinking
articles.title_cn: 抑制控制与语义丰富度调节自闭症谱系特征与创造性思维之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: Previous studies have reported inconsistent findings regarding creativity in individuals with autism spectrum condition (ASC). The present study treated ASC as a continuum and examined whether inhibitory control and semantic structure moderate the relationship between autistic characteristics and the originality and creative quality of divergent thinking. A mixed sample (n = 334), including participants on the autism spectrum and individuals from the general population, completed the Alternate Uses Task, which requires generating creative uses for common objects. The object probes differed in semantic richness: some were semantically scarce, with few associations, whereas others were semantically rich, with many associations. Although total ASC scores did not predict overall creative quality (considering originality and appropriateness of ideas), ASC was negatively associated with originality (probe-idea semantic distance) in responses to semantically rich probes but not to scarce probes. This effect was strongest among individuals with weaker inhibitory control. Analyses of specific autistic traits showed that difficulties with attention switching predicted greater originality. Moderating effects of inhibition and semantic structure also emerged for attention to patterns/details and imagination. Together, these findings highlight the importance of considering both the semantic richness of task prompts and individual differences in inhibitory control when investigating creativity in neurodivergence.
articles.abstract_cn: 以往研究关于自闭症谱系状况（ASC）个体创造力的报告结果不一致。本研究将ASC视为一个连续体，考察抑制控制和语义结构是否调节自闭症特征与发散思维独创性和创造性质量之间的关系。一个混合样本（n = 334），包括自闭症谱系参与者和一般人群个体，完成了替代用途任务，该任务要求为常见物体生成创造性用途。物体探针在语义丰富度上有所不同：有些语义稀缺，关联较少，而另一些语义丰富，关联较多。尽管ASC总分不能预测整体创造性质量（考虑想法的独创性和适当性），但ASC与对语义丰富探针的反应中的独创性（探针-想法语义距离）呈负相关，而对语义稀缺探针则无此关联。这种效应在抑制控制较弱的个体中最为显著。对特定自闭症特征的分析显示，注意力转换困难预测了更高的独创性。抑制和语义结构的调节效应也出现在对细节/模式的注意和想象力方面。总之，这些发现强调了在研究神经多样性个体的创造力时，考虑任务提示的语义丰富度和抑制控制的个体差异的重要性。

articles.title_en: Sentiment analysis and PANAS: Differential sensitivity to mood effects and personality traits
articles.title_cn: 情感分析与PANAS：对情绪效应和人格特质的不同敏感性
articles.abstract_en: Personality traits are known to relate to affective states, which are typically assessed using self-report questionnaires such as the Positive and Negative Affect Schedule (PANAS). The present study examined whether affective responses to mood induction are captured differently by PANAS and by sentiment analysis of brief free-text responses, and whether these measures show similar associations with personality traits. In an online randomized experiment, 95 participants were assigned to either a happy or sad mood induction procedure. Positive affect, negative affect, and linguistic valence were assessed before and after mood induction, and personality traits were measured using the NovoPsych Five Factor Personality Scale (NFFPS-30). Mood induction effects were detected by both PANAS and sentiment valence. Comparative analyses of standardized change scores indicated that sentiment valence showed greater sensitivity than PANAS Positive Affect, but not PANAS Negative Affect. By contrast, personality traits were more clearly associated with baseline self-reported affect than with linguistic valence, and only limited evidence was found for trait-based moderation of emotional reactivity. Overall, the findings suggest that free-text sentiment analysis may complement structured self-report scales by capturing mood-related change in partly distinct ways, whereas structured self-report measures may be more informative for personality–affect associations.
articles.abstract_cn: 已知人格特质与情感状态相关，这些状态通常通过自我报告问卷如积极和消极情感量表（PANAS）进行评估。本研究考察了情绪诱导的情感反应是否被PANAS和对简短自由文本的情感分析以不同方式捕捉，以及这些测量是否与人格特质表现出相似的关联。在一项在线随机实验中，95名参与者被分配到快乐或悲伤的情绪诱导程序中。在情绪诱导前后评估了积极情感、消极情感和语言效价，并使用NovoPsych五因素人格量表（NFFPS-30）测量人格特质。PANAS和情感效价均检测到情绪诱导效应。标准化变化分数的比较分析表明，情感效价比PANAS积极情感显示出更高的敏感性，但不比PANAS消极情感更敏感。相比之下，人格特质与基线自我报告情感的关系比与语言效价的关系更明显，并且仅发现有限的证据表明基于特质的情绪反应性调节。总体而言，研究结果表明，自由文本情感分析可能通过部分不同的方式捕捉情绪相关变化，从而补充结构化自我报告量表，而结构化自我报告测量可能对人格-情感关联更具信息量。

articles.title_en: Predicating without a lexical verb: Copula clauses and free nominals in Finnish
articles.title_cn: 不带词汇动词的谓语：芬兰语中的 Copula 从句和自由名词
articles.abstract_en: This article concerns predications made without a lexical verb in everyday conversations in Finnish. Two kinds of predications are compared: those done with clauses using the copula olla ‘be’ and free nominals, NPs and APs which have no syntactic role in any clause. The comparison shows that the two expressions were both used in categorizing, characterizing and identifying referents, but at different frequencies. In particular, copula clauses were much more likely to be used for characterizing than free nominals were. Free nominals had more diverse functions than copula clauses did, as they were used for certain functions, such as vocatives, which copula clauses were not used for. Furthermore, copula clauses occurred in both initial and subsequent positions in sequences of action, while free nominals strongly preferred subsequent positions. This indicates that copula clauses and free nominals are positionally sensitive linguistic formats. The methodology used in the study is Interactional Linguistics which combines usage-based and typological linguistics with Conversation Analysis. A basic tenet of Interactional Linguistics is that linguistic patterns are shaped by interaction and shape interaction on the other hand. Grammatical structures are seen as resources for performing particular actions, selected on the basis of their appropriateness in particular contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文涉及芬兰语日常对话中不使用词汇动词的谓语。比较了两种谓语：使用系词 olla ‘be’ 的从句和自由名词、NP 和 AP 进行的谓语，它们在任何从句中都没有句法作用。比较表明，这两种表达方式都用于分类、表征和识别所指对象，但使用频率不同。特别是，系词从句比自由名词更有可能用于表征。自由名词比系词从句具有更多样化的功能，因为它们用于某些功能，例如呼格，而系词从句不用于这些功能。此外，系词从句出现在动作序列的初始位置和后续位置，而自由名词强烈倾向于后续位置。这表明系词从句和自由名词是位置敏感的语言格式。该研究使用的方法是交互语言学，它将基于用法的语言学和类型学语言学与对话分析相结合。交互语言学的基本原则是语言模式是由交互塑造的，而另一方面又塑造交互。语法结构被视为执行特定动作的资源，根据其在特定上下文中的适当性进行选择。

articles.title_en: Social risk triggers conservative decision-making in women with high trait depression: Insights from hierarchical drift diffusion modeling
articles.title_cn: 社会风险触发高特质抑郁女性的保守决策：来自分层漂移扩散模型的洞见
articles.abstract_en: Accumulating evidence links clinical depression to impaired risky decision-making, particularly under social conditions. Yet the role of trait depression—a stable, subclinical disposition and precursor to clinical depression—in shaping risky decision-making remains poorly understood. This study adapted the Simple Gambling Task to include individual and social risk contexts and applied the Hierarchical Drift Diffusion Model (HDDM) to probe latent decision processes in women with high (n = 39) versus low (n = 40) trait depression. Results revealed that, in the high-trait group, social risk reduced risk-taking and elicited higher drift rates (v) toward conservative options, indicating rapid evidence accumulation for safe choices. In individual contexts, this group exhibited a starting point (z) closer to the safe boundary but lower drift rates (v), indicating inefficient integration of conservative information despite initial bias toward safety. The low-trait group, in turn, showed stable decision patterns across contexts. Critically, both starting point and drift rate in individual contexts reliably predict trait depression. These findings indicate that high trait depression is characterized by context-specific alterations in decision dynamics, with social risk amplifying avoidance and individual risk undermining safe choice processing. HDDM-derived parameters may therefore serve as behavioral-cognitive markers of depressive vulnerability and targets for early intervention.
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的证据将临床抑郁症与风险决策受损联系起来，尤其是在社会条件下。然而，特质抑郁——一种稳定的、亚临床的倾向，也是临床抑郁症的前兆——在塑造风险决策中的作用仍知之甚少。本研究改编了简单赌博任务，以包含个体和社会风险情境，并应用分层漂移扩散模型（HDDM）来探究高特质抑郁（n = 39）与低特质抑郁（n = 40）女性中的潜在决策过程。结果显示，在高特质组中，社会风险减少了冒险行为，并引发了对保守选项更高的漂移率（v），表明对安全选择的快速证据积累。在个体情境中，该组表现出更接近安全边界的起始点（z），但漂移率（v）较低，表明尽管初始偏向安全，但对保守信息的整合效率低下。相比之下，低特质组在不同情境中表现出稳定的决策模式。关键的是，个体情境中的起始点和漂移率均能可靠预测特质抑郁。这些发现表明，高特质抑郁的特征是决策动态的情境特异性改变，社会风险加剧回避行为，而个体风险削弱安全选择的处理过程。因此，HDDM-derived参数可能作为抑郁脆弱性的行为-认知标记，并成为早期干预的目标。

articles.title_en: Selective state-space models for Koopman-based data-driven distribution system state estimation
articles.title_cn: 基于Koopman的数据驱动配电系统状态估计的选择性状态空间模型
articles.abstract_en: Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) plays an increasingly-important role in modern power grids due to the integration of distributed energy resources (DERs). The inherent characteristics of distribution systems make classical estimation methods struggle, and recent advancements in data-driven learning methods, although promising, exhibit systematic failure in generalization and scalability that limits their applicability. In this work, we propose MambaDSSE, a model-free data-driven framework that incorporates Koopman-theoretic probabilistic filtering with a selective state-space model that learn to infer the underlying time-varying behavior of the system from data. We evaluate the model across a variety of test systems and scenarios, and demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms machine learning baselines on scalability, resilience to DER penetration levels, and robustness to data sampling rate irregularities. We further highlight the Mamba-based SSM’s ability to capture long range dependencies from data, improving performance on the DSSE task.
articles.abstract_cn: 配电系统状态估计（DSSE）在现代电网中扮演着越来越重要的角色，这得益于分布式能源资源（DERs）的整合。配电系统的固有特性使得经典估计方法难以应对，而近期数据驱动学习方法的进展虽然前景广阔，但在泛化和可扩展性方面表现出系统性失败，限制了其适用性。在这项工作中，我们提出了MambaDSSE，一种无模型的数据驱动框架，它结合了Koopman理论概率滤波与选择性状态空间模型，该模型从数据中学习推断系统的潜在时变行为。我们在多种测试系统和场景下评估了该模型，并证明所提出的方法在可扩展性、对DER渗透水平的韧性以及对数据采样率不规则性的鲁棒性方面优于机器学习基线。我们进一步强调了基于Mamba的SSM从数据中捕获长程依赖的能力，从而提高了DSSE任务的性能。

articles.title_en: Cascading-Aware Deployment of Decentralized Battery Energy Storage Systems: A Case Study of the Cyprus Islanded Power System
articles.title_cn: 考虑级联效应的分散式电池储能系统部署：以塞浦路斯孤岛电力系统为例
articles.abstract_en: Cascading failures pose significant frequency and voltage stability challenges in Renewable Energy Source (RES)-rich grids, especially when the system unintentionally splits, leading to widespread blackouts. This paper presents a novel method for identifying strategic buses for the deployment of decentralized battery energy storage systems (BESS), enabling islanded-mode operation to support split areas and thereby enhance grid resilience against cascading failures. The method performs risk-aware, budget-constrained optimal BESS allocation that accounts for load/RES uncertainty and worst credible contingencies, while integrating dynamic cascading-failure modelling and analysis to evaluate system-wide performance under BESS-provided grid support. It explicitly considers cascade-triggering mechanisms in frequency, voltage, and line loading—such as RoCoF, frequency nadir, voltage bounds, and thermal limits—together with a budget limit, by incorporating them into the optimization constraints. This enables optimal BESS allocation to mitigate cascading risks and enhance decentralized resilience by providing grid services such as voltage and frequency regulation, while reducing reliance on conventional load shedding, particularly during islanded operation through a virtual synchronous machine (VSM) control scheme. Implemented in the Cypriot power grid, the method demonstrates effectiveness in improving system resilience and reducing unsupplied load by 43.1%.
articles.abstract_cn: 级联故障在可再生能源丰富的电网中构成显著的频率和电压稳定性挑战，尤其是在系统意外解列时，可能导致大范围停电。本文提出了一种新方法，用于识别分散式电池储能系统（BESS）部署的战略母线，支持孤岛模式运行以支撑解列区域，从而增强电网抵御级联故障的韧性。该方法进行风险感知、预算受限的最优BESS配置，考虑负荷/可再生能源不确定性及最严重可信事故，同时集成动态级联故障建模与分析，以评估在BESS提供电网支撑下的系统级性能。它明确考虑了频率、电压和线路负载中的级联触发机制——如频率变化率（RoCoF）、频率最低点、电压界限和热限制——以及预算限制，并将其纳入优化约束中。这使得最优BESS配置能够通过提供电压和频率调节等电网服务来缓解级联风险并增强分散韧性，同时减少对传统甩负荷的依赖，特别是在通过虚拟同步机（VSM）控制方案进行孤岛运行期间。在塞浦路斯电网中的实施表明，该方法在提高系统韧性和减少未供电负荷方面有效，减少了43.1%。

articles.title_en: Co-planning of realistic urban multi-energy systems toward net-zero
articles.title_cn: 面向净零排放的现实城市多能源系统协同规划
articles.abstract_en: Achieving urban net-zero targets requires coordinated planning across electricity, heating, and gas systems while managing renewable supply and loads uncertainties. We present a co-planning framework integrating building-scale renewable energy hub optimization (REHO) with power grid’s distribution-level energy storage systems (ESSs) allocation and line reinforcement (LR). The building layer uses REHO to generate Pareto-optimal PV and net load profiles. The grid layer co-optimizes ESSs and LRs via a second-order cone optimal power flow relying on the Benders decomposition. Validation on a Swiss urban system with 2000 buildings demonstrates ESS and LR deployment cost reductions of 43.4% (2030), 38.2% (2040), and 34.1% (2050) versus a standard reactive planning. The framework deploys 6 MWh ESS and reinforces 15 lines, enabling PV growth from 2.9 MW to 27.7 MW while phasing out 762 oil boilers and reducing emissions by 53.6% by 2050, aligned with local utility’s net-zero targets. The approach uses standard solvers and scales to large networks, offering a practical pathway for urban energy system operators and municipalities to coordinate planning across sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 实现城市净零排放目标需要对电力、供热和燃气系统进行协调规划，同时管理可再生能源供应和负荷的不确定性。我们提出了一个协同规划框架，将建筑尺度的可再生能源枢纽优化（REHO）与电网配电层面的储能系统（ESS）配置和线路加固（LR）相结合。建筑层使用REHO生成帕累托最优的光伏和净负荷曲线。电网层通过基于Benders分解的二阶锥最优潮流对ESS和LR进行协同优化。在包含2000栋建筑的瑞士城市系统上的验证表明，与标准反应式规划相比，ESS和LR部署成本降低了43.4%（2030年）、38.2%（2040年）和34.1%（2050年）。该框架部署了6兆瓦时的ESS并加固了15条线路，使光伏装机从2.9兆瓦增长到27.7兆瓦，同时淘汰了762台燃油锅炉，到2050年减排53.6%，与当地公用事业的净零目标一致。该方法使用标准求解器，可扩展到大型网络，为城市能源系统运营商和市政当局提供跨部门协调规划的实用途径。

articles.title_en: Intelligent control of soft switching solid-state transformer in renewable microgrids using quokka swarm ANN
articles.title_cn: 基于袋熊群ANN的可再生微电网软开关固态变压器智能控制
articles.abstract_en: With the growing adoption of Renewable Energy Sources (RESs), the demand for efficient power management and conversion in microgrids has become crucial. This study presents a Hybrid Renewable Energy System (HRES)-based microgrid integrating Photovoltaic (PV), Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG)-based Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). A Soft Switching Solid-State Transformer (SS-SST)-based power conversion architecture is employed to enhance power stability, improve efficiency, and ensures seamless grid integration by contributing voltage regulation and power flow optimization. The Quokka Swarm Optimized Artificial Neural Network (ANN) Controller is implemented for dynamic duty cycle and voltage regulation, ensuring optimal performance under varying load conditions. The Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) generator is tuned using the Quokka Swarm Optimization (QSO) algorithm, significantly improving the control accuracy and reducing power losses. The proposed system is validated through MATLAB simulations and laboratory implementation, demonstrating enhanced voltage regulation and improved power efficiency compared to conventional controllers. The proposed QSO-ANN achieves a settling time of 55 ms, overshoot of <3%, steady-state error below 1% and efficiency up to 97%. The grid current Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) is reduced to below 0.1% in simulation and maintained within 1.5–1.8% in hardware experiments, complying with IEEE-519 standards.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源（RESs）的日益普及，微电网中高效电力管理和转换的需求变得至关重要。本研究提出了一种基于混合可再生能源系统（HRES）的微电网，集成了光伏（PV）、基于双馈感应发电机（DFIG）的风能转换系统（WECS）和电池储能系统（BESS）。采用基于软开关固态变压器（SS-SST）的功率转换架构，以增强电力稳定性、提高效率，并通过电压调节和潮流优化确保无缝并网。实现了袋熊群优化人工神经网络（ANN）控制器，用于动态占空比和电压调节，确保在变化负载条件下获得最优性能。脉冲宽度调制（PWM）发生器使用袋熊群优化（QSO）算法进行调谐，显著提高了控制精度并减少了功率损耗。通过MATLAB仿真和实验室实现验证了所提系统，与传统控制器相比，展示了增强的电压调节和改进的功率效率。所提出的QSO-ANN实现了55毫秒的稳定时间、小于3%的超调量、低于1%的稳态误差以及高达97%的效率。电网电流总谐波失真（THD）在仿真中降至0.1%以下，并在硬件实验中保持在1.5-1.8%范围内，符合IEEE-519标准。

articles.title_en: Three-dimensional omnidirectional wireless power transfer system with optimized magnetic field control
articles.title_cn: 基于优化磁场控制的三维全向无线电能传输系统
articles.abstract_en: To address the issues of two-dimensional planar wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, whose transmission performance is constrained by receiver coil position, resulting in poor misalignment tolerance, insufficient spatial freedom, and power transfer blind spots, this paper proposes a three-dimensional orthogonal omnidirectional WPT system based on directed magnetic field regulation. First, three-dimensional orthogonal decoupled transmitter coils are employed to achieve uniform spatial magnetic field coverage. Subsequently, a circuit model of the system is established, and the functional relationship among transmission efficiency, mutual inductance, and phase-shift angles is derived. Furthermore, a regulation method based on mutual inductance parameter identification and optimal phase-shift angle calculation is proposed. By solving for the optimal combination of phase-shift angles, the WPT system achieves maximum transmission efficiency at different receiver positions. Experimental results demonstrate that the three-dimensional orthogonal transmitter coils possess omnidirectional power transfer capability, enabling stable energy transmission regardless of the receiver coil's position and orientation in space. Under directed magnetic field regulation, the system achieves a maximum spatial transmission efficiency of 81% at a distance of 22.5 cm from the center of the transmitter assembly, validating the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对二维平面无线电能传输（WPT）系统因接收线圈位置受限而导致传输性能受约束、错位容忍度差、空间自由度不足以及存在功率传输盲区的问题，本文提出了一种基于定向磁场调控的三维正交全向WPT系统。首先，采用三维正交解耦发射线圈以实现均匀的空间磁场覆盖。随后，建立了系统的电路模型，推导了传输效率、互感与移相角之间的函数关系。进一步，提出了一种基于互感参数辨识和最优移相角计算的调控方法。通过求解最优移相角组合，WPT系统在不同接收位置下实现最大传输效率。实验结果表明，三维正交发射线圈具备全向功率传输能力，无论接收线圈在空间中的位置和方向如何，都能实现稳定的能量传输。在定向磁场调控下，系统在距发射组件中心22.5厘米处实现了最大空间传输效率81%，验证了所提方法的有效性和优越性。

articles.title_en: Optimal market-aware scheduling and control of EV batteries in second-life usage
articles.title_cn: 二次使用中电动汽车电池的最佳市场感知调度和控制
articles.abstract_en: As the share of renewable energy in power systems increases, the resulting need for additional flexibility can be supported by second-life battery energy storage systems. However, their operation is complicated by the heterogeneity of the constituent battery packs. This paper addresses this challenge by proposing an optimization framework that uses battery packs’ losses as a proxy for battery degradation. The proposed two-stage framework (i) optimizes the participation of multiple second-life battery packs, each connected to its own DC/DC converter, in the Frequency Containment Reserve and day-ahead markets, while enforcing a specific constraint to ensure homogeneous degradation of each pack, and (ii) employs a model predictive control-based convex optimization to track market commitments while equalizing resistive losses among the batteries. The framework is validated in simulation across three scenarios with varying initial conditions, demonstrating effectiveness in balancing performance and degradation among heterogeneous battery packs.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源在电力系统中所占份额的增加，二次电池储能系统可以支持对额外灵活性的需求。然而，由于组成电池组的异构性，它们的操作变得复杂。本文通过提出一种优化框架来解决这一挑战，该框架使用电池组的损耗作为电池退化的代理。所提出的两阶段框架（i）优化了多个第二寿命电池组的参与，每个电池组连接到自己的DC/DC转换器，在频率遏制储备和日前市场中，同时实施特定的约束以确保每个电池组的均匀退化，以及（ii）采用基于模型预测控制的凸优化来跟踪市场承诺，同时均衡电池之间的电阻损耗。该框架在具有不同初始条件的三种场景中进行了仿真验证，证明了平衡异构电池组性能和退化的有效性。

articles.title_en: Neural network-assisted model predictive control for implicit balancing
articles.title_cn: 基于神经网络辅助的模型预测控制在隐式平衡中的应用
articles.abstract_en: In Europe, balance responsible parties can deliberately take out-of-balance positions to support transmission system operators (TSOs) in maintaining grid stability and earn profit, a practice called implicit balancing. Model predictive control (MPC) is widely adopted as an effective approach for implicit balancing. The balancing market model accuracy in MPC is critical to decision quality. Previous studies modeled this market using either (i) a convex market clearing approximation, ignoring proactive manual actions by TSOs and the market sub-quarter-hour dynamics, or (ii) machine learning methods, which cannot be directly integrated into MPC. To address these shortcomings, we propose a data-driven balancing market model integrated into MPC using an input convex neural network to ensure convexity while capturing uncertainties. To keep the core network computationally efficient, we incorporate attention-based input gating mechanisms to remove irrelevant data. Evaluating on Belgian data shows that the proposed model both improves MPC decisions and reduces computational time.
articles.abstract_cn: 在欧洲，平衡责任方可以故意采取不平衡头寸以支持输电系统运营商（TSOs）维持电网稳定并赚取利润，这种做法称为隐式平衡。模型预测控制（MPC）被广泛采用作为隐式平衡的有效方法。MPC中平衡市场模型的准确性对决策质量至关重要。以往的研究要么使用（i）凸市场清算近似模型，忽略了TSOs的主动手动操作和市场的亚刻钟动态，要么使用（ii）机器学习方法，这些方法无法直接集成到MPC中。为解决这些不足，我们提出了一种数据驱动的平衡市场模型，集成到MPC中，使用输入凸神经网络确保凸性同时捕捉不确定性。为保持核心网络的计算效率，我们引入了基于注意力的输入门控机制以去除不相关数据。在比利时数据上的评估表明，所提出的模型既改善了MPC决策，又减少了计算时间。

articles.title_en: Characterisation of short-circuit impact response of oil-immersed transformer winding based on photoelectric coupling measurement
articles.title_cn: 基于光电耦合测量的油浸式变压器绕组短路冲击响应特性研究
articles.abstract_en: During transformer operation, short-circuit currents can induce mechanical deformation of windings, compromising structural stability and operational safety. This study presents a systematic investigation of winding mechanical response under short-circuit conditions. A test platform integrating a winding structural model, a short-circuit current simulation system, and an opto-electrical coupled deformation measurement system was developed for high-precision acquisition and analysis of axial and radial deformations under various operating scenarios. By controlling peak short-circuit current and winding turns, key response signals were extracted, establishing the relationship between current amplitude and deformation. Results indicate that winding deformation under short-circuit impact exhibits damped oscillatory behavior, with axial and spoke deformations lagging peak current, reflecting typical hysteretic elasticity of metallic materials. Single-impact deformation increases with current amplitude following a power-exponential relationship and grows with the number of turns. Under repeated impacts, deformation accumulates progressively and undergoes a sudden transition upon reaching a threshold, with amplitude nearly doubling compared with the stable stage. These findings provide theoretical guidance for transformer winding design, short-circuit strength assessment, and online monitoring strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 在变压器运行过程中，短路电流会引起绕组机械变形，影响结构稳定性和运行安全。本研究对短路条件下绕组机械响应进行了系统研究。搭建了一个集成绕组结构模型、短路电流模拟系统和光电耦合变形测量系统的测试平台，用于在各种运行场景下高精度采集和分析轴向和径向变形。通过控制峰值短路电流和绕组匝数，提取了关键响应信号，建立了电流幅值与变形之间的关系。结果表明，短路冲击下的绕组变形表现出阻尼振荡行为，轴向和辐向变形滞后于峰值电流，反映了金属材料的典型滞弹性。单次冲击变形随电流幅值增加而增大，遵循幂指数关系，并随匝数增加而增大。在重复冲击下，变形逐渐累积，并在达到阈值时发生突变，幅值相比稳定阶段几乎翻倍。这些发现为变压器绕组设计、短路强度评估和在线监测策略提供了理论指导。

articles.title_en: Scalable iterative algorithm for solving optimal transmission switching with de-energization
articles.abstract_en: Transmission System Operators routinely use transmission switching as a tool to manage congestion and ensure system security. Motivated by sub-transmission operations at RTE, this paper considers the Optimal Transmission Switching with De-energization (OTSD), which captures potential loss of connectivity (and therefore localized blackout) following loss of transmission elements. While directly relevant to real-life operations, this problem has received very little attention in the literature. The paper proposes a new mixed-integer linear programming formulation for OTSD that represents post-contingency loss of connectivity without requiring additional binary variables. This new formulation provides the foundation for a fast, iterative heuristic algorithm. Computational experiments confirms that state-of-the-art optimization solvers struggle to solve the extensive formulation of OTSD, often failing to find even trivial solutions within reasonable time. In contrast, numerical results demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed heuristic, which finds high-quality feasible solutions 100–1000x faster than using Gurobi.

articles.title_en: Adaptive protection scheme for modern power systems: A comprehensive machine learning framework
articles.title_cn: 现代电力系统的自适应保护方案：一个综合机器学习框架
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a real-time Adaptive Protection Scheme (APS) for Medium-Voltage (MV) distribution networks with high penetration of inverter-based Distributed Energy Resources (DER). The framework combines offline and online operational phases for improving overcurrent protection coordination and decision stability under realistic operating conditions. This paper proposes a robust real-time selection algorithm for the protection groups, embedding explicit anomaly detection and anti-flapping mechanisms on top of a previously validated adaptive engine. The online algorithm includes a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based current measurement filter and outlier detector, and a support vector machine (SVM) for mapping filtered real-time current measurements to the pre-defined protection settings groups. A multi-criteria anti-flapping logic is then applied to enforce membership-based confidence, temporal dwell times, and M-of-N persistence before issuing setting group changes. The adaptive protection scheme is IEC 61850-compliant and can be demonstrated in real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups. Extensive short circuit studies on the IEEE 33 bus test feeder across multiple distributed energy resources (DER) penetration levels and two fault resistance regimes (solid, 0 Ω; and 30 Ω) show a 99.9% successful fault clearing rate, with improved selectivity, sensitivity, and overall robustness of the protection scheme while significantly reducing spurious setting oscillations under DER ramps, noisy measurements, and sensor dropouts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对高渗透率基于逆变器的分布式能源（DER）的中压（MV）配电网，提出了一种实时自适应保护方案（APS）。该框架结合了离线和在线运行阶段，以改善在实际运行条件下的过流保护协调和决策稳定性。本文提出了一种鲁棒的实时保护组选择算法，在先前验证的自适应引擎之上嵌入了显式异常检测和防抖机制。在线算法包括基于变分自编码器（VAE）的电流测量滤波器和异常检测器，以及用于将滤波后的实时电流测量映射到预定义保护设置组的支持向量机（SVM）。然后应用多准则防抖逻辑，在发出设置组变更之前强制执行基于成员资格的置信度、时间驻留时间和M-of-N持续性。该自适应保护方案符合IEC 61850标准，并可在实时仿真和硬件在环（HIL）设置中演示。在IEEE 33节点测试馈线上，跨多个分布式能源（DER）渗透水平和两种故障电阻制度（固态，0 Ω；和30 Ω）进行的广泛短路研究表明，成功清除故障率为99.9%，提高了保护方案的选择性、灵敏度和整体鲁棒性，同时显著减少了在DER爬坡、噪声测量和传感器丢失情况下的虚假设置振荡。

articles.title_en: Unified sensitivity-based heuristic for optimal line switching and substation reconfiguration
articles.title_cn: 基于统一灵敏度的启发式方法用于最优线路切换和变电站重构
articles.abstract_en: Optimal transmission switching (OTS) determines which transmission lines to remove from service to minimize dispatch costs. Unlike topology design, it alters the operational status of operating lines. Sensitivity-based methods, as advanced optimization techniques, select lines whose outage yields a significant cost reduction. However, these methods overlook bus splitting, an effective congestion management strategy that our work incorporates to achieve improved economic gains. In this work, we formulate an optimal transmission reconfiguration (OTR) problem that incorporates both line switching and bus splitting. We develop a novel approach to quantify the sensitivity of the OTR objective to line switching and bus splitting, establish connections between the proposed sensitivity framework and existing heuristic metrics, prove the equivalence between bus splitting and a generalized line switching to enable unified treatment, and provide a simpler derivation of Bus Split Distribution Factor (BSDF). Simulations on nine IEEE test systems spanning 118 to 13,659 buses demonstrate the high effectiveness of our proposed sensitivity method. They also demonstrate that incorporating bus splitting into transmission reconfiguration achieves greater cost savings than line switching alone. The results confirm the economic advantage of this comprehensive approach to transmission system operation.
articles.abstract_cn: 最优输电切换（OTS）确定哪些输电线路退出运行以最小化调度成本。与拓扑设计不同，它改变运行线路的运行状态。基于灵敏度的方法作为先进的优化技术，选择那些退出运行能带来显著成本降低的线路。然而，这些方法忽略了母线分裂，这是一种有效的拥堵管理策略，我们的工作将其纳入以实现更好的经济效益。在这项工作中，我们构建了一个包含线路切换和母线分裂的最优输电重构（OTR）问题。我们开发了一种新方法来量化OTR目标对线路切换和母线分裂的灵敏度，建立了所提出的灵敏度框架与现有启发式指标之间的联系，证明了母线分裂与广义线路切换之间的等价性以实现统一处理，并提供了母线分裂分布因子（BSDF）的更简单推导。在跨越118到13,659个母线的九个IEEE测试系统上的仿真证明了我们提出的灵敏度方法的高效性。它们还表明，将母线分裂纳入输电重构比单独进行线路切换能实现更大的成本节约。结果证实了这种综合方法在输电系统运行中的经济优势。

articles.title_en: Vision-based defect detection of transmission line insulators in rainy and foggy weather
articles.title_cn: 雨雾天气下基于视觉的输电线路绝缘子缺陷检测
articles.abstract_en: Condition monitoring of insulators via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is crucial for power grid reliability. However, adverse meteorological conditions introduce severe visual noise, leading to feature degradation and an elevated risk of missed detections in automated inspection systems. In this article, an all-weather, improved insulator defect detection algorithm MM-DEIM is proposed. First, to mitigate the scarcity of low-visibility defect data, a physically consistent 3D weather synthesis algorithm is proposed. By incorporating atmospheric scattering laws and spatial depth priors, it generates high-fidelity synthetic data. Within the defect detection model, a Modulated Large-Kernel Aggregation (MLKA) module is introduced. This module can reconstruct the physical morphology of broken edges under intense background noise. Concurrently, a Cross Stage Partial Magnitude-aware Linear Attention (CSPMALA) mechanism is employed to prevent the attenuation of weak defect signals during multi-scale transmission. Experimental results demonstrate that MM-DEIM achieves a mean average precision (mAP@.5) of 86.4% on the mixed-weather benchmark. With robust cross-domain generalization and a 2.75 ms inference latency, the framework meets UAV edge computing constraints, providing a practical inspection solution for power system maintenance.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过无人机对绝缘子进行状态监测对于电网可靠性至关重要。然而，不利的气象条件会引入严重的视觉噪声，导致特征退化，并增加自动检测系统中漏检的风险。本文提出了一种全天候改进的绝缘子缺陷检测算法MM-DEIM。首先，为缓解低可见度缺陷数据稀缺的问题，提出了一种物理一致的3D天气合成算法。通过结合大气散射定律和空间深度先验，该算法生成高保真合成数据。在缺陷检测模型中，引入了调制大核聚合模块。该模块能够在强烈背景噪声下重建断裂边缘的物理形态。同时，采用跨阶段部分幅度感知线性注意力机制，以防止多尺度传输过程中弱缺陷信号的衰减。实验结果表明，MM-DEIM在混合天气基准上实现了平均精度均值（mAP@.5）为86.4%。凭借强大的跨域泛化能力和2.75毫秒的推理延迟，该框架满足无人机边缘计算约束，为电力系统维护提供了实用的检测解决方案。

articles.title_en: A synchrophasor estimator characterized by attenuated self-interference and robustness against DC offsets: The DCSOGI interpolated DFT
articles.title_cn: 一种具有衰减自干扰和对直流偏移鲁棒性的同步相量估计器：DCSOGI插值DFT
articles.abstract_en: The second-order generalized integrator (SOGI), which can be used to attenuate the self-interference of the fundamental tone, is unable to fully reject DC offsets on the input signal. Consequently, the performance of any SOGI based synchrophasor estimation (SE) technique might be compromised in the presence of such DC components. The current work presents a SE algorithm which adopts an enhanced SOGI formulation, robust against DC, combined with a three-point IpDFT and a three nominal fundamental period Hanning observation window. Its simultaneous compliance with both phasor measurement unit (PMU) P and M performance classes is assessed by means of a simulated environment where all the operating conditions defined by the IEC/IEEE 60255-118-1:2018 standard are evaluated combined with a 10% static DC offset and under two different noise levels. Furthermore, the method adopts a dedicated mechanism for the detection of low amplitude 2nd harmonic tones and the correction of their impacts under off-nominal frequency conditions. Finally, its resilience against multiple simultaneous harmonic interferences is also analyzed together with its performance in the presence of decaying DC components.
articles.abstract_cn: 二阶广义积分器（SOGI）可用于衰减基波的自干扰，但无法完全抑制输入信号上的直流偏移。因此，在存在此类直流分量的情况下，任何基于SOGI的同步相量估计（SE）技术的性能可能会受到影响。当前工作提出了一种SE算法，该算法采用增强的SOGI公式，对直流具有鲁棒性，并结合三点IpDFT和三个标称基波周期的汉宁观测窗口。通过模拟环境评估其同时符合相量测量单元（PMU）P和M性能等级的情况，该环境涵盖了IEC/IEEE 60255-118-1:2018标准定义的所有操作条件，并结合10%的静态直流偏移以及两种不同噪声水平。此外，该方法采用专用机制来检测低幅度2次谐波，并校正其在偏离标称频率条件下的影响。最后，还分析了其在多个同时谐波干扰下的鲁棒性，以及在存在衰减直流分量时的性能。

articles.title_en: Detection and localization of stealthy false data injection attacks in DC microgrids via graph attention reinforcement learning
articles.title_cn: 基于图注意力强化学习的直流微电网隐蔽虚假数据注入攻击检测与定位
articles.abstract_en: Direct current microgrids (DCmGs) are emerging as critical components in modern power systems. However, their increasing reliance on communication networks renders them particularly susceptible to cyberattacks, especially false data injection (FDI) attacks. A recently disclosed variant of stealthy FDI attacks, leveraging unknown inputs, poses a severe challenge to system security by evading traditional unknown input observer detection mechanisms and degrading the control performance of DCmGs. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel graph attention reinforcement learning (GARL) security framework. The framework formulates the tasks of attack detection and localization as a unified Markov decision process, in which the agent’s action space simultaneously represents both the existence and the specific location of an attack. The framework integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) agent with a graph attention network (GAT), enabling the exploitation of the DCmG’s inherent topological structure. By dynamically capturing spatiotemporal dependencies among nodes, the agent can adaptively detect anomalies and accurately localize compromised components. The proposed method effectively combines the decision-making adaptability of RL with the powerful graph representation capability of GAT. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly outperforms baseline models, achieving a location accuracy of 98.26%, an F1 score of 99.53%, and a false alarm rate (FAR) as low as 0.21%. Moreover, it exhibits strong resilience under various physical and network disturbances and generalizes effectively from stealthy to general FDI attacks, highlighting its robustness and broad applicability.
articles.abstract_cn: 直流微电网（DCmGs）正成为现代电力系统中的关键组成部分。然而，其对通信网络日益增长的依赖使其特别容易受到网络攻击，尤其是虚假数据注入（FDI）攻击。最近披露的一种利用未知输入的隐蔽FDI攻击变体，通过规避传统的未知输入观测器检测机制并降低直流微电网的控制性能，对系统安全构成了严峻挑战。为应对这一挑战，本文提出了一种新颖的图注意力强化学习（GARL）安全框架。该框架将攻击检测与定位任务表述为一个统一的马尔可夫决策过程，其中智能体的动作空间同时表示攻击的存在性和具体位置。该框架将强化学习（RL）智能体与图注意力网络（GAT）相结合，能够利用直流微电网固有的拓扑结构。通过动态捕获节点间的时空依赖性，智能体可以自适应地检测异常并准确定位受损组件。所提出的方法有效结合了强化学习的决策适应性与图注意力网络的强大图表示能力。实验结果表明，所提出的框架显著优于基线模型，实现了98.26%的定位准确率、99.53%的F1分数以及低至0.21%的误报率（FAR）。此外，它在各种物理和网络扰动下表现出强大的鲁棒性，并能从隐蔽FDI攻击有效泛化到一般FDI攻击，凸显了其稳健性和广泛适用性。

articles.title_en: Towards an open-source real-time operator-training platform: Analysis of computational efficiency
articles.title_cn: 迈向开源实时操作员培训平台：计算效率分析
articles.abstract_en: Real-time operator-training platforms require dynamic power-system simulation that executes within strict SCADA refresh-rate constraints while preserving high modeling fidelity. This challenge is particularly critical for Transmission System Operators, who must train personnel to manage large-scale transmission networks under realistic contingency scenarios and topology changes. This paper evaluates the real-time performance of the time-domain power system simulator underpinning an operator-training environment. Using Dynaωo as the dynamic simulation engine, we quantify solver efficiency, stability, and scalability on commodity hardware under event-driven scenarios (loss of busbar section, line, and generator). A benchmarking protocol stabilizes the environment and profiles the time-domain integration window. Performance is assessed via step solving times and headroom relative to SCADA-rate synchronization. Results show faster-than-real-time execution in normal operation and for simplified substation-detail configurations, with brief spikes at disturbance instants linked to Jacobian restructuring. Increasing topology retention preserves operational fidelity but expands the number of discrete and continuous states, causing occasional real-time violations during events. We analyze hotspots and outline optimization levers, including solver tolerances, time-step control, sparse linear algebra, and event handling. The study demonstrates the feasibility of open-source dynamic simulation for operator training while identifying operational boundaries and practical paths to robust sustained real-time performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 实时操作员培训平台需要动态电力系统仿真，该仿真必须在严格的SCADA刷新率约束下执行，同时保持高建模保真度。这一挑战对于输电系统运营商尤为关键，他们必须培训人员在现实应急场景和拓扑变化下管理大型输电网络。本文评估了支撑操作员培训环境的时域电力系统仿真器的实时性能。使用Dynaωo作为动态仿真引擎，我们在事件驱动场景（母线区段、线路和发电机损失）下量化了商用硬件上的求解器效率、稳定性和可扩展性。基准测试协议稳定了环境并分析了时域积分窗口。性能通过步进求解时间和相对于SCADA速率同步的余量进行评估。结果表明，在正常操作和简化变电站细节配置下，执行速度快于实时，扰动瞬间出现短暂尖峰，这与雅可比矩阵重构有关。增加拓扑保留保持了操作保真度，但扩大了离散和连续状态的数量，导致事件期间偶尔出现实时违规。我们分析了热点并概述了优化杠杆，包括求解器容差、时间步控制、稀疏线性代数和事件处理。该研究证明了开源动态仿真在操作员培训中的可行性，同时识别了操作边界和实现稳健持续实时性能的实用路径。

articles.title_en: Active-power control strategies in grid-forming power converters to improve transient stability in power systems with 100% converter-based generation
articles.title_cn: 并网电力转换器中的有功功率控制策略可提高基于 100% 转换器发电的电力系统的瞬态稳定性
articles.abstract_en: Grid-forming voltage source converters (GFM-VSC) play a crucial role in the stability of power systems with large amounts of converter-based generation. Transient stability (angle stability under large disturbances) is a critical limiting factor in stressed power systems. Previous studies have proposed control strategies for GFM-VSCs to improve transient stability. These approaches typically rely on suitable current-limiting algorithms, voltage/reactive-power and active-power supplementary control strategies. This paper investigates and compares the effectiveness of three active-power control strategies in GFM-VSCs to enhance transient stability in power systems with 100% converter-based generation: (i) a wide-area control strategy (TSP-WACS) using the centre of inertia (COI) frequency, (ii) a local transient damping method (TSP-TDM), and (iii) a novel local control strategy (TSP-L) proposed in this work. All strategies were implemented and assessed using short-circuit simulations on Kundur´s two-area test system with 100% GFM-VSC generators, demonstrating critical clearing time (CCT) improvement. The TSP-WACS strategy achieves the best performance but requires a communication infrastructure, while TSP-L strategy offers a simple, robust alternative using only local measurements.
articles.abstract_cn: 并网电压源换流器（GFM-VSC）对于大量基于换流器发电的电力系统的稳定性起着至关重要的作用。暂态稳定性（大扰动下的角度稳定性）是受压电力系统的关键限制因素。先前的研究提出了 GFM-VSC 的控制策略，以提高瞬态稳定性。这些方法通常依赖于合适的限流算法、电压/无功功率和有功功率补充控制策略。本文研究并比较了 GFM-VSC 中三种有功功率控制策略的有效性，以增强基于 100% 转换器的发电系统的暂态稳定性：(i) 使用惯性中心 (COI) 频率的广域控制策略 (TSP-WACS)，(ii) 局部暂态阻尼方法 (TSP-TDM)，以及 (iii) 本文提出的一种新颖的本地控制策略 (TSP-L)。所有策略均使用带有 100% GFM-VSC 发生器的 Kundur 两区域测试系统上的短路模拟来实施和评估，证明了关键清除时间 (CCT) 的改进。 TSP-WACS 策略实现了最佳性能，但需要通信基础设施，而 TSP-L 策略提供了一种仅使用本地测量的简单、强大的替代方案。

articles.title_en: Real-time detection of islanding and electromechanical oscillations in power systems via clustering in low-rank subspace
articles.title_cn: 基于低秩子空间聚类的电力系统孤岛与机电振荡实时检测
articles.abstract_en: Monitoring electromechanical oscillations and islanding is crucial for ensuring the stability of modern power systems, particularly with the increasing penetration of inverter-based resources. Existing model-based and data-driven methods have shown potential but face challenges in robustness and computational efficiency, limiting their real-time application in TSO’s control rooms. This study proposes a novel data-driven approach for detecting electromechanical oscillations and network islanding in large-scale power systems. The method leverages only streaming frequency measurements from Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) and employs advanced techniques, including Model Order Reduction technique and clustering algorithm such as Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering. This enables the identification of disconnected network areas or coherent oscillatory regions with high accuracy, robustness, and computational efficiency. The approach is validated through real-world case studies in the European grid, including normal operation, the 2021 Continental Europe Synchronous Area separation, and the December 2016 oscillatory event. Results confirm its suitability for real-time stability monitoring.
articles.abstract_cn: 监测机电振荡和孤岛对于确保现代电力系统的稳定性至关重要，尤其是在逆变器型资源渗透率不断提高的情况下。现有的基于模型和数据驱动的方法显示出潜力，但在鲁棒性和计算效率方面面临挑战，限制了其在输电系统运营商控制室中的实时应用。本研究提出了一种新颖的数据驱动方法，用于检测大规模电力系统中的机电振荡和网络孤岛。该方法仅利用来自相量测量单元（PMU）的流式频率测量值，并采用先进技术，包括模型降阶技术和聚类算法（如层次凝聚聚类）。这使得能够以高精度、鲁棒性和计算效率识别断开的网络区域或相干振荡区域。该方法通过欧洲电网的实际案例研究进行了验证，包括正常运行、2021年欧洲大陆同步区域分离以及十二月2016年振荡事件。结果证实了其适用于实时稳定性监测。

articles.title_en: Integrated Grid-Forming Control with Angle-Forming and Current Limitation for Synchronous Inverters
articles.title_cn: 同步逆变器的集成构网控制：角度构网与电流限制
articles.abstract_en: Fault ride-through capabilities are essential for grid-forming (GFM) inverters, particularly for providing ancillary services such as fault reactive current injection and phase jump active power delivery. Conventional GFM controllers, often based on cascaded voltage-current control structures, involve complex designs, require meticulous parameter tuning, and complicate analysis. To address these issues, we previously introduced a hybrid strategy that switches between GFM and current controllers. However, while this approach effectively limits current magnitude during grid disturbances, it fails to preserve the crucial voltage angle-forming characteristic adequately. This paper extends this hybrid strategy with a controller designed to maintain the voltage angle-forming characteristic while concurrently limiting the current magnitude. This integrated approach facilitates the independent design of the GFM and current controllers and ensures the delivery of ancillary services mandated by grid codes. Numerical simulations of a single-phase synchronous inverter during grid disturbances verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller.
articles.abstract_cn: 故障穿越能力对于构网（GFM）逆变器至关重要，尤其是在提供辅助服务（如故障无功电流注入和相角跳变有功功率输送）方面。传统的GFM控制器通常基于级联电压-电流控制结构，设计复杂，需要精细的参数整定，并增加了分析难度。为解决这些问题，我们先前引入了一种在GFM控制器和电流控制器之间切换的混合策略。然而，尽管该方法在电网扰动期间能有效限制电流幅值，却未能充分保持关键的电压角度构网特性。本文扩展了这一混合策略，增加了一种控制器，旨在维持电压角度构网特性的同时限制电流幅值。这种集成方法便于GFM控制器和电流控制器的独立设计，并确保提供电网规范要求的辅助服务。对单相同步逆变器在电网扰动期间的数值仿真验证了所提控制器的有效性。

articles.title_en: Advanced dynamic phasor-based modeling and load-flow analysis of unsymmetrical two-phase induction machines
articles.title_cn: 非对称两相感应电机的先进动态相量建模与潮流分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a dynamic phasor-based modeling approach for unsymmetrical two-phase induction machines, deriving steady-state equations to support initialization and load-flow simulations. The machine formulation reveals coupling between positive and negative sequence components and exhibits stronger nonlinearity compared to the Electromagnetic Transient (EMT) models. The resulting differential equations are discretized using the trapezoidal integration method with critical damping adjustment (CDA) to provide a stable numerical solution. A companion circuit is then constructed using the Modified Augmented Nodal Analysis (MANA). An iterative solution is applied to obtain accurate results. The proposed method is implemented in C++, and both transient and load-flow simulations are validated on the IEEE 13-Bus test system using EMTP®. Results demonstrate high accuracy and robust numerical solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于动态相量的非对称两相感应电机建模方法，推导了稳态方程以支持初始化和潮流仿真。该电机公式揭示了正序和负序分量之间的耦合，并且与电磁暂态（EMT）模型相比表现出更强的非线性。所得微分方程采用带临界阻尼调整（CDA）的梯形积分法进行离散化，以提供稳定的数值解。随后，使用修正增广节点分析（MANA）构建伴随电路。采用迭代求解以获得精确结果。所提方法在C++中实现，并在IEEE 13节点测试系统上使用EMTP®对暂态和潮流仿真进行了验证。结果表明该方法具有高精度和稳健的数值解。

articles.title_en: An approach to mapping operation conditions to levels of generation rejection for the SIPS of the Brazilian North-Southeast HVDC bipoles
articles.title_cn: 一种将运行条件映射到巴西东北-东南高压直流双极SIPS切机水平的方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents an approach for mapping operation conditions to required levels of generation rejection, with the aim of parameterizing the arming function of the Special Integrity Protection Scheme (SIPS) of the Brazilian North-Southeast High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) bipoles. The purpose of the SIPS is to ensure the transient stability of the Brazilian Interconnected Power System (BIPS) after contingencies in the Brazilian North-Southeast HVDC bipoles. The proposed approach relies on a boundary search algorithm to characterize security hyperplanes of operation conditions for selected levels of generation rejection. Case studies with data provided by the Brazilian System Operator (BSO) have been used to validate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种将运行条件映射到所需切机水平的方法，旨在参数化巴西东北-东南高压直流双极的特殊完整性保护方案（SIPS）的布防功能。SIPS的目的是确保巴西互联电力系统（BIPS）在巴西东北-东南高压直流双极发生事故后的暂态稳定性。所提出的方法依赖于边界搜索算法，以刻画选定切机水平下的运行条件安全超平面。使用巴西系统运营商（BSO）提供的数据进行的案例研究已验证了所提方法的有效性和适用性。

articles.title_en: Maximal load shedding verification for neural network models of AC line switching
articles.title_cn: 交流线路切换神经网络模型的最大负荷削减验证
articles.abstract_en: Solving for globally optimal line switching decisions in AC transmission grids can be intractably slow. Machine learning (ML) models, meanwhile, can be trained to predict near-optimal decisions at a fraction of the speed. Verifying the performance and impact of these ML models on network operation, however, is a critically important step prior to their actual deployment. In this paper, we train a Neural Network (NN) to solve the optimal power shutoff line switching problem. To assess the worst-case load shedding induced by this model, we propose a bilevel attacker-defender verification approach that finds the NN line switching decisions that cause the highest quantity of network load shedding. Solving this problem to global optimality is challenging (due to AC power flow and NN nonconvexities), so our approach exploits a convex relaxation of the AC physics, combined with a local NN search, to find a guaranteed lower bound on worst–case load shedding. These under-approximation bounds are solved via MathOptAI.jl. We benchmark against a random sampling approach, and we find that our optimization-based approach always finds larger load shedding, by an average margin of 33% in the largest test case. Test results are collected on multiple PGLib test cases and on trained NN models which contain more than 10 million model parameters.
articles.abstract_cn: 在交流输电网中求解全局最优线路切换决策可能难以处理地缓慢。与此同时，机器学习（ML）模型可以被训练以极快的速度预测接近最优的决策。然而，在实际部署之前，验证这些ML模型对网络运行的性能和影响是至关重要的一步。在本文中，我们训练了一个神经网络（NN）来解决最优断电线路切换问题。为了评估该模型引起的最坏情况负荷削减，我们提出了一种双层攻击者-防御者验证方法，该方法找到导致最大网络负荷削减量的NN线路切换决策。由于交流潮流和NN非凸性，将这个问题求解到全局最优具有挑战性，因此我们的方法利用交流物理的凸松弛，结合局部NN搜索，以找到最坏情况负荷削减的保证下界。这些欠逼近下界通过MathOptAI.jl求解。我们与随机采样方法进行基准比较，发现我们的基于优化的方法总能找到更大的负荷削减，在最大测试案例中平均差距为33%。测试结果在多个PGLib测试案例和包含超过10百万模型参数的训练NN模型上收集。

articles.title_en: Stacking revenues from energy and reserve markets through the aggregation of flexible demands
articles.title_cn: 通过聚合灵活需求在能源和备用市场中叠加收入
articles.abstract_en: Retailers traditionally deploy demand response (DR) mainly to reduce procurement costs in energy markets, overlooking the potential to leverage flexible loads in reserve or flexibility markets. This paper proposes a two-stage, data-driven framework that enables retailers to stack revenues from energy and reserve markets through the aggregation of flexible demands. The first stage employs inverse optimization (IO) to infer flexible load parameters from historical price and consumption data, while the second stage formulates a bilevel model capturing the strategic interaction between the retailer and the system operator. The bilevel problem is reformulated as a Mathematical Program with Equilibrium Constraints (MPEC) and McCormick envelopes. Applied to the Chilean electricity market, results show that multi-market DR participation increases retailer profits fourfold and reduces system reserve procurement costs by 8.91% during the actives hours of the demand response procurement, underscoring DR’s role in enhancing flexibility and delivering system-wide savings.
articles.abstract_cn: 零售商传统上主要部署需求响应（DR）以降低能源市场的采购成本，忽视了在备用或灵活性市场中利用灵活负荷的潜力。本文提出了一个两阶段、数据驱动的框架，使零售商能够通过聚合灵活需求在能源和备用市场中叠加收入。第一阶段采用逆优化（IO）从历史价格和消费数据中推断灵活负荷参数，而第二阶段则构建了一个双层模型，捕捉零售商与系统运营商之间的战略互动。该双层问题被重构为具有均衡约束的数学规划（MPEC）和McCormick包络。应用于智利电力市场，结果表明，多市场需求响应参与使零售商利润增加四倍，并在需求响应采购的活跃时段内将系统备用采购成本降低8.91%，凸显了需求响应在增强灵活性和实现系统级节约方面的作用。

articles.title_en: FPAA-based new generation cyber-attack resilient static frequency relay
articles.title_cn: 基于FPAA的新一代网络攻击弹性静态频率继电器
articles.abstract_en: Digital protective relays are the primary protection in most power systems applications and now interface with cyber layers in modern grids, improving observability and control. However, this integration also introduces cybersecurity risks, as digital relays are digital computers, vulnerable to cyber-attacks and malicious code. A compromised frequency relay can cause false tripping of generators, transformers, or undesired load shedding, potentially leading to blackouts. This paper presents the development of FPAA-based next-generation static frequency relays (over/under frequency and ROCOF) that are inherently resilient to cyber-attacks. The proposed relay operates in parallel with existing digital frequency relays, enhancing the cybersecurity of current protection systems. It is modelled for the Western Interconnection, compliant with NERC PRC-024-3 standards, and tested under multiple scenarios. Hardware testing is performed using the AN231K04-QUAD FPAA board. Results confirm the relay’s dependability and selectivity, supporting its potential to improve the cyber-resilience of existing frequency protection schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 数字保护继电器是大多数电力系统应用中的主要保护，现在与现代电网中的网络层接口，提高了可观测性和控制能力。然而，这种集成也带来了网络安全风险，因为数字继电器是数字计算机，容易受到网络攻击和恶意代码的影响。受损的频率继电器可能会导致发电机、变压器误跳闸或意外的负载脱落，从而可能导致停电。本文介绍了基于 FPAA 的下一代静态频率继电器（过频/欠频和 ROCOF）的开发，该继电器本质上能够抵御网络攻击。拟议的继电器与现有的数字频率继电器并行运行，增强了当前保护系统的网络安全。它针对西部互联进行建模，符合 NERC PRC-024-3 标准，并在多种场景下进行了测试。使用 AN231K04-QUAD FPAA 板执行硬件测试。结果证实了继电器的可靠性和选择性，支持其提高现有频率保护方案的网络弹性的潜力。

articles.title_en: Online rapid MIMO frequency scanning using binary complementary codes
articles.title_cn: 基于二元互补码的在线快速MIMO频率扫描
articles.abstract_en: Small-signal stability assessment and monitoring in converter-dominated grids can be performed using frequency-response (FR) data that can be acquired online with minimal perturbation. This paper applies complementary binary codes as excitations for simultaneous multi-input multi-output (MIMO) frequency scanning. These codes are also referred to as Golay-Rudin-Shapiro (GRS) sequences, after their inventors. We exploit their complementary autocorrelation and composite spectral flatness to derive a correlation- and cross-spectral FR estimator, and include a guard interval to capture the impulse-response tail during admittance estimation. Hadamard modulation preserves complementarity and yields orthogonal channels for MIMO identification. A unified simulation framework benchmarks GRS against the more common pseudorandom binary sequences and multisines under identical constraints, such as injection time, signal energy and realistic noise levels. Accuracy and efficiency are compared using the log-integrated normalized mean square error (NMSE) and computation time. The admittance estimation is demonstrated for three systems including different passive networks with background harmonics and a power converter. The proposed GRS approach consistently shows comparable or better metrics with less injected energy. Therefore, these features, combined with its DSP-friendly implementation and short injection time, make GRS a practical and efficient solution for online FR acquisition and system monitoring.
articles.abstract_cn: 在换流器主导的电网中，小信号稳定性评估和监测可以通过频率响应（FR）数据实现，这些数据可以在最小扰动下在线获取。本文应用二元互补码作为激励，用于同时进行多输入多输出（MIMO）频率扫描。这些码也被称为Golay-Rudin-Shapiro（GRS）序列，以其发明者命名。我们利用其互补自相关和复合频谱平坦性，推导出相关和互谱FR估计器，并在导纳估计期间包含保护间隔以捕获脉冲响应尾部。Hadamard调制保持互补性，并为MIMO识别提供正交通道。一个统一的仿真框架在相同约束条件下，如注入时间、信号能量和实际噪声水平，将GRS与更常见的伪随机二元序列和多正弦信号进行基准比较。使用对数积分归一化均方误差（NMSE）和计算时间比较准确性和效率。导纳估计在三个系统中得到验证，包括具有背景谐波的不同无源网络和一个功率换流器。所提出的GRS方法始终显示出相当或更好的指标，且注入能量更少。因此，这些特性，加上其DSP友好的实现和短注入时间，使GRS成为在线FR采集和系统监测的实用且高效的解决方案。

articles.title_en: Automated and robust system discovery in power systems assets using physics-informed machine learning
articles.title_cn: 基于物理信息机器学习的电力系统资产自动化稳健系统发现
articles.abstract_en: System discovery, such as parameter estimation or model reconstruction, in complex power system assets can play crucial roles in condition monitoring, troubleshooting and root cause analysis. However, robust system discovery in presence of noisy or sparse data is a challenging problem that requires solving an inverse problem and quantifying uncertainties. In this paper we address this problem and propose an approach to find the solution by using Physics-Informed Machine Learning approach for modeling cause and effect in power systems assets with polynomial dynamics. In a probabilistic setting we establish the merits of the proposed approach using empirical results. In particular, we benchmark our proposed end-to-end method with a baseline that uses Bayesian Neural Network with dropout and show that our approach outperforms baseline by 79% of reduction of validation error, 34% reduction of training time and 97.5% reduction of inference time.
articles.abstract_cn: 在复杂的电力系统资产中进行系统发现，如参数估计或模型重建，在状态监测、故障排除和根本原因分析中可发挥关键作用。然而，在存在噪声或稀疏数据的情况下，稳健的系统发现是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要解决逆问题并量化不确定性。在本文中，我们解决了这一问题，并提出了一种使用物理信息机器学习方法对具有多项式动态的电力系统资产中的因果关系进行建模的方法。在概率框架下，我们通过实证结果确立了所提方法的优点。具体而言，我们将所提出的端到端方法与使用带丢弃法的贝叶斯神经网络的基线进行基准比较，并表明我们的方法在验证误差减少79%、训练时间减少34%和推理时间减少97.5%方面优于基线。

articles.title_en: Machine learning guided optimal transmission switching to mitigate wildfire ignition risk
articles.title_cn: 机器学习引导的最优输电切换以缓解野火引燃风险
articles.abstract_en: To mitigate acute wildfire ignition risks, utilities de-energize power lines in high-risk areas. The Optimal Power Shutoff (OPS) problem optimizes line energization statuses to manage wildfire ignition risks through de-energizations while reducing load shedding. OPS problems are computationally challenging Mixed-Integer Linear Programs (MILPs) that must be solved rapidly and frequently in operational settings. For a particular power system, OPS instances share a common structure with varying parameters related to wildfire risks, loads, and renewable generation. This motivates the use of Machine Learning (ML) for solving OPS problems by exploiting shared patterns across instances. In this paper, we develop an ML-guided framework that quickly produces high-quality de-energization decisions by extending existing ML-guided MILP solution methods while integrating domain knowledge on the number of energized and de-energized lines. Results on a large-scale realistic California-based synthetic test system show that the proposed ML-guided method produces high-quality solutions faster than traditional optimization methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 为缓解严重的野火引燃风险，公用事业公司对高风险区域的输电线路进行断电。最优断电（OPS）问题优化线路通电状态，通过断电管理野火引燃风险，同时减少负荷削减。OPS问题是计算上具有挑战性的混合整数线性规划（MILP），在运营环境中必须快速且频繁地求解。对于特定电力系统，OPS实例共享共同结构，但参数随野火风险、负荷和可再生能源发电而变化。这促使利用机器学习（ML）通过利用实例间的共享模式来求解OPS问题。本文中，我们开发了一个ML引导框架，通过扩展现有的ML引导MILP求解方法，并整合关于通电和断电线路数量的领域知识，快速生成高质量的断电决策。在一个大规模、基于加利福尼亚州的现实合成测试系统上的结果表明，所提出的ML引导方法比传统优化方法更快地产生高质量解决方案。

articles.title_en: “What do you think?”: Lexical bundles as indexes of (im)politeness in Wikipedia's collaborative culture
articles.title_cn: “你怎么看？”：词汇束作为维基百科协作文化中（不）礼貌的索引
articles.abstract_en: This article presents a novel corpus-based approach to (im)politeness research, grounded in Terkourafi's theory of politeness as conventionalization, which highlights the frequent use of linguistic forms in specific contexts as key to developing politeness meanings. We propose lexical bundles – recurrent multi-word sequences – as a systematic tool for tracking (im)politeness in discourse. To illustrate this approach, we examine Wikipedia editors' communication, a context shaped by norms promoting civility. Using the Wikipedia Politeness Corpus as our data source, we extracted 108 interactive lexical bundles (1076 tokens) and identified four primary politeness-related functions they serve: seeking consensus, fostering collaboration, expressing criticism/disagreement, and mitigating conflict/imposition. A significant finding is the multifunctionality of many bundles, which shift functions depending on context or simultaneously perform multiple politeness-related roles. Not all bundles in our dataset function as conventionalized politeness formulae; many are less-conventionalized or non-conventionalized expressions that convey politeness-oriented meanings. A bundle's degree of conventionalization depends on its frequency, functional consistency, and context-dependence. These findings underscore the context-sensitive nature of politeness, revealing the nuanced interplay between linguistic form and situational elements, as well as the adaptability of lexical bundles to the pragmatic needs of interlocutors. Our study demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed approach for capturing (im)politeness in discourse, establishing the value of lexical bundles as a robust tool for corpus-pragmatic research. By applying this approach to Wikipedia editors' interactions, we highlight its potential to advance the study of (im)politeness in regulated, collaborative online environments and demonstrate its broader applicability to diverse discursive contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种基于语料库的（不）礼貌研究新方法，该方法基于Terkourafi的礼貌常规化理论，该理论强调语言形式在特定语境中的频繁使用是礼貌意义发展的关键。我们提出将词汇束——反复出现的多词序列——作为追踪话语中（不）礼貌的系统性工具。为说明该方法，我们考察了维基百科编辑者的交流，这一语境受到促进文明规范的影响。以维基百科礼貌语料库为数据来源，我们提取了108个互动性词汇束（1076个词次），并确定了它们所服务的四个主要礼貌相关功能：寻求共识、促进协作、表达批评/异议以及缓和冲突/强加。一个重要发现是许多词汇束具有多功能性，其功能随语境变化或同时承担多种礼貌相关角色。并非我们数据集中的所有词汇束都作为常规化的礼貌公式起作用；许多是较少常规化或未常规化的表达，传达礼貌导向的意义。词汇束的常规化程度取决于其频率、功能一致性和语境依赖性。这些发现强调了礼貌的语境敏感性，揭示了语言形式与情境因素之间微妙的相互作用，以及词汇束对交际者语用需求的适应性。我们的研究证明了所提方法在捕捉话语中（不）礼貌方面的有效性，确立了词汇束作为语料库语用研究稳健工具的价值。通过将该方法应用于维基百科编辑者的互动，我们强调了其在受规范约束的协作性在线环境中推进（不）礼貌研究的潜力，并展示了其对多样化话语语境的更广泛适用性。

articles.title_en: A simulation study on withstand capability of surge arresters for pole-mounted switches on distribution lines considering failure probability
articles.title_cn: 考虑失效概率的配电线路柱上开关避雷器耐受能力仿真研究
articles.abstract_en: In the Hokuriku area of Japan, surge arresters are commonly installed on pole-mounted switches as lightning protection measures. This paper examines a rationalization measure to reduce the withstand capability of surge arresters used for switch protection. Using lightning surge simulations, the failure probability of surge arresters caused by direct lightning strikes to distribution lines is analyzed, and the effectiveness of the rationalization measure is evaluated based on the analytical results. The study shows the following findings. (1) Telecommunication wires commonly installed on actual distribution lines have the effect of reducing the failure probability of surge arresters. On distribution lines equipped with an overhead ground wire, the presence of a telecommunication wire reduces the failure probability of surge arresters to approximately 20%. (2) When the withstand capability of surge arresters used for switch protection is reduced to one half, the failure probability of surge arresters on distribution lines with an overhead ground wire increases by approximately 1.9 times. However, this failure probability is still approximately 30–40% lower than that of surge arresters installed on non‑terminal or terminal poles. (3) If the proposed rationalization measure is fully implemented in actual distribution lines in the Hokuriku area, it is estimated that the increase in lightning‑induced failures of surge arresters would be very small, at approximately 5%.
articles.abstract_cn: 在日本北陆地区，柱上开关通常安装避雷器作为防雷措施。本文探讨了一种降低开关保护用避雷器耐受能力的合理化措施。通过雷电冲击仿真，分析了配电线路遭受直接雷击时避雷器的失效概率，并基于分析结果评估了该合理化措施的有效性。研究得出以下结论。（1）实际配电线路中常见的通信线具有降低避雷器失效概率的作用。在装有架空地线的配电线路上，通信线的存在使避雷器的失效概率降低至约20%。（2）当开关保护用避雷器的耐受能力降低至一半时，装有架空地线的配电线路上避雷器的失效概率增加约1.9倍。然而，该失效概率仍比安装在非终端或终端电杆上的避雷器低约30-40%。（3）如果所提出的合理化措施在北陆地区的实际配电线路中全面实施，估计避雷器雷电引发故障的增加将非常小，约为5%。

articles.title_en: Improving spatial allocation for energy system coupling with graph neural networks
articles.title_cn: 利用图神经网络改进能源系统耦合的空间分配
articles.abstract_en: In energy system analysis, coupling models with mismatched spatial resolutions is a significant challenge. A common solution is assigning weights to high-resolution geographic units for aggregation, but traditional models are limited by using only a single geospatial attribute. This paper presents an innovative method employing a self-supervised Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network to address this issue. This method models high-resolution geographic units as graph nodes, integrating various geographical features to generate physically meaningful weights for each grid point. These weights enhance the conventional Voronoi-based allocation method, allowing it to go beyond simply geographic proximity by incorporating essential geographic information. In addition, the self-supervised learning paradigm overcomes the lack of accurate ground-truth data. Experimental results demonstrate that applying weights generated by this method to cluster-based Voronoi Diagrams significantly enhances scalability, accuracy, and physical plausibility, while increasing precision compared to traditional methods. Code is available at https://github.com/KIT-IAI/AllocateGNN
articles.abstract_cn: 在能源系统分析中，耦合空间分辨率不匹配的模型是一个重大挑战。常见的解决方案是为高分辨率地理单元分配权重以进行聚合，但传统模型受限于仅使用单一地理空间属性。本文提出了一种创新方法，采用自监督异构图神经网络来解决这一问题。该方法将高分辨率地理单元建模为图节点，整合多种地理特征，为每个网格点生成具有物理意义的权重。这些权重增强了传统的基于Voronoi的分配方法，使其能够超越单纯的地理邻近性，纳入关键的地理信息。此外，自监督学习范式克服了缺乏准确地面真实数据的问题。实验结果表明，将这种方法生成的权重应用于基于聚类的Voronoi图，显著提高了可扩展性、准确性和物理合理性，同时与传统方法相比提高了精度。代码可在 https://github.com/KIT-IAI/AllocateGNN 获取。

articles.title_en: Modeling of time-window ramping and time-averaged environmental constraints in short term hydrothermal problems
articles.title_cn: 短期水电问题中时间窗口爬坡与时间平均环境约束的建模
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents the formulation of time-window averaged (TWA) and time-window ramping (TWR) hydraulic constraints within the short-term hydrothermal scheduling problem. Conventional instantaneous hydraulic constraints enforce strict limits at every time step, which can result in an overly restrictive behavior in highly discretized horizons. The proposed formulations introduce time-window constraints, providing more flexible alternatives to instantaneous limits and enabling a more realistic representation of operational flexibility. The TWA formulation imposes bounds on average values of hydraulic variables within daily or weekly windows, while the TWR formulation restricts variations between consecutive windows or periodic time points. Both constraints can be applied to variables such as discharge, spillage, and storage. The paper also addresses upstream water level constraints, whose nonlinear relationships are approximated as constraints on stored volume, in order to preserve model linearity. The proposed formulations were validated on real test cases from the Brazilian Independent System Operator, confirming their practical applicability in large-scale hydrothermal systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了短期水电调度问题中时间窗口平均（TWA）和时间窗口爬坡（TWR）水力约束的公式化表达。传统的瞬时水力约束在每个时间步长强制执行严格限制，这在高离散化时间范围内可能导致过度限制的行为。所提出的公式引入了时间窗口约束，为瞬时限制提供了更灵活的替代方案，并能够更真实地表示运行灵活性。TWA公式对日或周窗口内水力变量的平均值施加界限，而TWR公式则限制连续窗口或周期性时间点之间的变化。这两种约束均可应用于诸如出流量、弃水量和蓄水量等变量。本文还处理了上游水位约束，其非线性关系被近似为对蓄水体积的约束，以保持模型的线性。所提出的公式在巴西独立系统运营商的真实测试案例上进行了验证，确认了其在大规模水电系统中的实际适用性。

articles.title_en: The sweet spot of bound tightening for topology optimization
articles.title_cn: 拓扑优化中边界收紧的最佳平衡点
articles.abstract_en: Topology optimization has emerged as a powerful and increasingly relevant strategy for enhancing the flexibility and efficiency of power system operations. However, solving these problems is computationally demanding due to their combinatorial nature and the use of big-M formulations. Optimization-based bound tightening (OBBT) is a well-known strategy to improve the solution of mixed-integer linear programs (MILPs) by computing tighter bounds for continuous variables. Yet, existing OBBT approaches in topology optimization typically relax all switching decisions in the bounding subproblems, leading to excessively loose feasible regions and limited bound improvements. In this work, we propose a topology-aware bound tightening method that uses network structure to determine which switching variables to relax. Through extensive computational experiments on the IEEE 118-bus system, we find that keeping a small subset of switching variables as binary, while relaxing the rest, strikes a sweet spot between the computational effort required to solve the bounding problems and the tightness of the resulting bounds.
articles.abstract_cn: 拓扑优化已成为增强电力系统运行灵活性和效率的一种强大且日益相关的策略。然而，由于这些问题的组合性质以及大M公式的使用，求解这些问题在计算上要求很高。基于优化的边界收紧（OBBT）是一种众所周知的策略，通过为连续变量计算更紧的边界来改进混合整数线性规划（MILPs）的求解。然而，现有的拓扑优化中的OBBT方法通常在所有边界子问题中放宽所有开关决策，导致可行域过于宽松，边界改进有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种拓扑感知的边界收紧方法，利用网络结构来确定放宽哪些开关变量。通过在IEEE 118节点系统上的大量计算实验，我们发现保持一小部分开关变量为二进制，同时放宽其余变量，在求解边界问题所需的计算工作量与所得边界的紧度之间达到了最佳平衡点。

articles.title_en: What makes demand wait? Modeling cross-day flexibility in electric vehicle charging
articles.title_cn: 什么导致需求等待？电动汽车充电跨日灵活性的建模
articles.abstract_en: This study proposes an interpretable framework for understanding the dynamics of daily electric vehicle (EV) charging demand using three years of residential charging data from Denmark. By aligning daily boundaries with charging demand peaks, we uncover behavioral patterns driven by price signals, routines, seasonality, and weather. A key insight is that EV users react more consistently to relative price changes, especially changes in nighttime prices relative to the previous day, than to absolute values. Demand also shows strong routine and seasonal influences, with nighttime prices dominating in winter and midday prices becoming more influential in summer. Comparing machine-learning algorithms (Random Forest, Catboost) with a Linear Regression model, we demonstrate that the latter provides the best balance between performance and interpretability, indicating distinct weakly patterns of aggregated charging behavior. Overall, the proposed framework offers a structured approach to uncovering EV demand dynamics, providing system operators and flexibility providers with clear, actionable insights.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提出了一个可解释的框架，利用丹麦三年的住宅充电数据来理解日常电动汽车充电需求的动态。通过将每日边界与充电需求峰值对齐，我们揭示了由价格信号、日常习惯、季节性和天气驱动的行为模式。一个关键见解是，电动汽车用户对相对价格变化的反应更为一致，尤其是夜间价格相对于前一天的变化，而非绝对价格值。需求还显示出强烈的日常和季节性影响，冬季夜间价格占主导地位，而夏季中午价格的影响更大。通过比较机器学习算法（随机森林、Catboost）与线性回归模型，我们证明了后者在性能和可解释性之间提供了最佳平衡，表明聚合充电行为存在明显的弱模式。总体而言，所提出的框架提供了一种结构化的方法来揭示电动汽车需求动态，为系统运营商和灵活性提供者提供了清晰、可操作的见解。

articles.title_en: Data-driven risk management for peer-to-peer energy trading with feasibility guarantee
articles.title_cn: 具有可行性保证的点对点能源交易数据驱动风险管理
articles.abstract_en: The growing integration of renewable energy sources (RESs) introduces significant uncertainty in peer-to-peer trading within distribution networks, posing challenges to strategy optimality and system reliability. This paper presents a data-driven risk management framework that explicitly accounts for RES uncertainty to guarantee trading feasibility. By embedding scenario-based statistical feasibility constraints within a generalized Nash game, the method enables both prosumers and the distribution network operator to make risk-aware decisions without assuming known probability distributions. Furthermore, an iterative scenario removal technique is developed to mitigate conservativeness arising from excessive scenario inclusion. Simulation results validate the proposed approach’s effectiveness in balancing economic performance and strategy feasibility.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源（RESs）的日益整合在配电网内的点对点交易中引入了显著的不确定性，对策略最优性和系统可靠性构成挑战。本文提出了一种数据驱动的风险管理框架，明确考虑RES不确定性以保证交易可行性。通过在广义纳什博弈中嵌入基于情景的统计可行性约束，该方法使产消者和配电网运营商都能在无需假设已知概率分布的情况下做出风险感知决策。此外，开发了一种迭代情景移除技术，以减轻因过度包含情景而产生的保守性。仿真结果验证了所提方法在平衡经济绩效和策略可行性方面的有效性。

articles.title_en: Optimizing surplus hydropower sales under liquidity constraints and risk management in the free contracting market
articles.title_cn: 在自由签约市场中的流动性约束与风险管理下优化剩余水电销售
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) model for optimizing surplus hydropower sales in Brazil’s Free Contracting Market (ACL) under operational constraints and market volatility. The proposed framework integrates (i) dynamic liquidity constraints calibrated from historical trading activity, (ii) multi-horizon energy contracts (daily, monthly, quarterly, and semiannual), and (iii) risk management through Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR). Unlike related portfolio and contract-optimization models that typically neglect execution limits or adopt static volume caps, our formulation embeds time- and product-dependent liquidity envelopes and minimum-lot constraints in a single MILP with CVaR-based risk control. Computational experiments using 2000 price scenarios quantify the trade-off between expected revenue and tail-risk mitigation across different values of the risk-aversion parameter λ.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型，用于在巴西自由签约市场（ACL）中，在运营约束和市场波动下优化剩余水电销售。所提出的框架整合了（i）根据历史交易活动校准的动态流动性约束，（ii）多期限能源合同（日、月、季度和半年），以及（iii）通过条件风险价值（CVaR）进行风险管理。与通常忽略执行限制或采用静态交易量上限的相关投资组合和合同优化模型不同，我们的公式在具有基于CVaR的风险控制的单一MILP中嵌入了时间和产品依赖的流动性包络以及最小批量约束。使用2000个价格情景的计算实验量化了不同风险厌恶参数λ值下预期收入与尾部风险缓解之间的权衡。

articles.title_en: Optimal scheduling of flexible resources under uncertainty in multi-energy systems
articles.title_cn: 多能源系统中不确定性下灵活资源的最优调度
articles.abstract_en: With the increasing penetration of renewable energy and the rising demand for decarbonization, multi-energy systems integrating electricity, heat, and transportation sectors have attracted significant attention. However, the intermittency and uncertainty of renewable generation in integrated energy systems (IES) makes it difficult to ensure cost-effective and coordinated operation across different energy carriers, often leading to suboptimal use of system flexibility and increased operational risk. This paper proposes a robust optimization framework for integrated electric and thermal energy systems with vehicle-to-grid (V2G) enabled electric vehicles. This approach employs a linearized model for the distribution network and a constant flow variable temperature (CFVT) methodology for the heating system to balance accuracy and computational tractability. A two-stage formulation captures day-ahead EV charging commitments and real-time adaptive dispatch against wind generation uncertainty. An exact column-and-constraint generation algorithm ensures solution scalability and worst-case feasibility. Simulations on an IEEE 15-bus network and a 5-node district heating system illustrate the cost–robustness trade-off achieved by leveraging EV and thermal flexibility under the proposed robust scheduling approach, compared with stochastic scheduling.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源渗透率的提高和脱碳需求的增加，整合电力、热力和交通部门的多能源系统引起了广泛关注。然而，综合能源系统（IES）中可再生能源发电的间歇性和不确定性使得确保不同能源载体之间的成本效益和协调运行变得困难，常常导致系统灵活性利用不足和运行风险增加。本文提出了一种针对集成电力和热力系统以及具备车辆到电网（V2G）功能的电动汽车的鲁棒优化框架。该方法采用配电网的线性化模型和供热系统的恒定流量变温度（CFVT）方法，以平衡精度和计算可行性。一个两阶段公式捕捉了日前电动汽车充电承诺和针对风力发电不确定性的实时自适应调度。一种精确的列与约束生成算法确保了解决方案的可扩展性和最坏情况下的可行性。在IEEE 15节点网络和5节点区域供热系统上的仿真结果表明，与随机调度相比，所提出的鲁棒调度方法通过利用电动汽车和热力灵活性实现了成本-鲁棒性权衡。

articles.title_en: Islanding detection in grid-connected inverter-based systems using synchro-waveform measurements
articles.title_cn: 基于同步波形测量的并网逆变器系统孤岛检测
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a passive islanding detection method for grid-connected inverter-based system (IBS), leveraging synchro-waveform measurements. The proposed approach continuously monitors three-phase voltage and current signals at the point of common coupling (PCC) using a waveform measurement unit (WMU). A theoretical threshold is derived to represent the maximum permissible variation between consecutive samples of a sinusoidal waveform under normal grid-connected conditions. An islanding event is detected when the measured voltage variation exceeds this threshold. The method is validated through simulations of a photovoltaic (PV) plant connected to the IEEE 9-bus test system using the Hypersim real-time simulator. Results demonstrate reliable islanding detection in approximately 0.1 ms while remaining robust under large load variations and non-islanding disturbances. Unlike traditional RMS-based techniques, the proposed method exploits instantaneous waveform dynamics, enabling detection under challenging power balance conditions associated with the non-detection zone (NDZ). Since the technique does not rely on external perturbations or communication channels, it introduces no power quality degradation and is suitable for near real-time implementation in modern distributed inverter-based power systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种利用同步波形测量的被动式孤岛检测方法，适用于并网逆变器系统（IBS）。所提方法通过波形测量单元（WMU）持续监测公共耦合点（PCC）处的三相电压和电流信号。推导了一个理论阈值，用以表示在正常并网条件下正弦波形连续采样点之间的最大允许变化。当测得的电压变化超过该阈值时，即检测到孤岛事件。该方法通过在Hypersim实时仿真器上对连接至IEEE 9节点测试系统的光伏（PV）电站进行仿真验证。结果表明，该方法能在约0.1毫秒内可靠检测孤岛，同时在大负载变化和非孤岛扰动下保持稳健性。与传统基于RMS的技术不同，所提方法利用瞬时波形动态，能够在与非检测区（NDZ）相关的具有挑战性的功率平衡条件下实现检测。由于该技术不依赖外部扰动或通信信道，因此不会引入电能质量下降，适用于现代分布式逆变器电力系统中的近实时实现。
